name: pi-audit-loopsec
description: A pi extension that runs a code audit as /loopsec: it enumerates the attack surface, works one item at a time under anti-rabbit-hole limits (round cap, plateau, pause budget, one-item assignment), and writes a triage report where every finding carries an openable artifact. Append-only JSONL state in .pi-loopsec, crash-recoverable, exFAT-safe.
